key_claims: Excessive physical exercise affects brain chemistry in addition to muscles.
Exhaustive training without adequate rest alters dopamine regulation in the hippocampus.
The hippocampus is a brain region closely linked to memory and the regulation of emotions.
limitations: Specific mechanisms and broader impacts beyond the hippocampus are not detailed in the source.
